nodes.label: Three-Stage Pipeline Architecture
nodes.rationale: Using three separate stages (Generate, Validate, Threshold) isolates network requests, allows offline parser corrections/adjustments without API costs, and enables fast cutoff tuning on stored scores.

nodes.label: LLM Role as Memory Recall
nodes.rationale: LLM's job is memory recall of poetry, not prosody reasoning. Eliminates system prompts, spelled-out meter feet, and personas to focus purely on recall.

nodes.label: Registry (registry.pkl)
nodes.rationale: A single source of truth flat table tracking per-verse status and metrics, enabling incremental retries of only failed/pending verses without modifying source input.

nodes.label: Text Fidelity Check
nodes.rationale: Strict check ensuring the LLM only adds diacritics and never changes underlying letters, avoiding creative fixes. Normalizes orthographic variance (alef, hamza, tatweel) before exact match.

nodes.label: pyarud Scoring
nodes.rationale: Scores verses individually against labeled meter as ground truth. Treats low scores as not-verified and exceptions as failed_parse to retry later.
